scope: One fixed user-provided construction plus independent finite check of a geometric obstruction lemma. No full mapping enumeration or optimization.
pin_to_position: pin 5*j+l receives ordered entry l of Cj

model.reuse: Only exact reuse of a complete five-input median result for identical translated five-point sample sets; all scalar inputs; no data-dependent shortcuts.
model.primitive: Every newly computed median uses the existing seven-comparator module; no sharing of individual comparator results.
model.domain: Steady-state interior output density on the full lattice; finite-image initialization, boundary and memory/control costs excluded.
model.outer: One fresh seven-comparator outer median per output.
model.quantity: 7*(number_of_translation_classes_of_inner_blocks+1) comparator evaluations per output; not circuit area or timing.

acceptance: Five disjoint blocks of size five cover the grid
Quarter turns act as C0 fixed, C1-C4 cyclic
Input pin map is a bijection, induced rotations permute whole logical modules
Independent five-point-set check has zero eligible noncentral sets congruent to their quarter-turn by translation

independent_check.domain: All C(25,5)=53130 five-point subsets; test quarter-turn translation equivalence only; do not construct partitions or evaluate functions.
